_comment: Tool-facing hardware declaration for Space Invaders (Midway/Taito) on the mw8080bw PCB.
ROM_START(invaders)) and mw8080bw.h. Same role as the Konami boards' hardware.json: the single
source of truth the shared Python tools read via --hardware. Numbers are decimal; '_hex'/'_note'
fields are annotations the loader ignores.
★ FIRST-DRAFT for the 8080 skeleton -- unlike the Konami/Z80 boards this is an Intel 8080 with a
TWO-interrupt-per-frame RST model and PORT (not memory-mapped) I/O. Items marked ★ need confirming
against MAME at first boot (the equivalence gate).
_cpu_note: Intel 8080 (MAME i8080). See core/cpu/8080.js -- ALU/register model, not an interpreter.

screen._note: mw8080bw.h: HTOTAL 0x140/HBEND 0, VTOTAL 0x106/VBEND 0, VBSTART 0xe0 -> visible 256x224 PRE-rotation. ROT270 (mw8080bw.cpp:3305 GAMEL invaders) -> displayed 224 wide x 256 tall. Exact ROT lives in the manifest.

_cycles_note: 1996800 / 59.541985 = 33536. ★ confirm the CPU actually retires ~33536 cyc/frame vs MAME.

stateRegions.name: main_ram
stateRegions._hex: 0x2000-0x3FFF work RAM (0x2000-0x23FF) + 1bpp video framebuffer (0x2400-0x3FFF). .mirror(0x4000) aliases at 0x6000-0x7FFF (same bytes, not a separate region).

_writeRanges_note: No memory-mapped hardware writes -- all devices (shift reg, watchdog, sound) are on the 8080 OUT PORT space (boards/invaders/io.js portOut), not the memory bus. Port writes are the write-diff surface, traced in io.js if needed.

cpuReset._note: 8080 reset pinned vs MAME i8080: device_start AF=0, device_reset leaves it -> PC=0, regs 0, raw F=0x00. The always-1 flag bit1 is applied only on PUSH PSW, not the working register.

interrupt._note: ★ NOT the single-NMI model the shared tools assume. Two maskable (INTE via EI/DI) RST interrupts per frame; vector computed from the vsync-chain counter (mw8080bw.cpp interrupt_vector = 0xc7 | ((counter&0x40)>>2) | ((~counter&0x40)>>3)).
